items.desc: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, web/controle/control.php authorizes FuncionarioControle requests only by checking whether an authenticated employee has a permission row for resource 11 or 91, while MiddlewareDAO::verificarPermissao() does not compare the stored id_acao value or authorize the requested method. An employee with any such permission and a valid CSRF token from the employee's own session can invoke FuncionarioControle::adicionarPermissao, FuncionarioControle::alterarPermissao, or FuncionarioControle::excluirPermissao to add, change, or remove permissions for arbitrary roles. This can grant higher action levels over sensitive resources, expose or modify protected employee, patient, configuration, and administrative data, or disrupt legitimate access by changing other roles. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

Prior to 3.7.18 and 4.3.2, the Media Library MediaManager::onCropImage and cropImage path accepts a user-controlled destination filename without applying the default_extensions allowlist enforced by the normal upload path. An authenticated backend user with media.library.create permission can upload arbitrary bytes under an allowed extension and use the zero-dimension crop branch, which performs a byte-for-byte File::copy, to write those bytes into the public media folder under an attacker-selected extension. Default server configurations block PHP execution in that folder, but HTML or SVG output can produce stored cross-site scripting in the application origin; non-default servers that execute PHP in the media directory can expose remote code execution. This vulnerability is fixed in 3.7.18 and 4.3.2.

items.desc: Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.4.0, a frame with sandbox="" can reach and execute a javascript: URL through declarative refresh because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs can reach JavaScript URL handling in components/script/script_thread.rs without enforcing the sandbox's script prohibition. This gives attacker-controlled content arbitrary JavaScript execution in a frame intended to be scriptless, including nested DOM probe creation and blind browser requests. The frame retains an opaque origin, so the issue does not by itself provide parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.4.0.

items.desc: Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.3.0, a sandboxed iframe can use declarative refresh to auto-navigate because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs does not enforce the sandboxed automatic-features flag. The bypass occurs with sandbox="", sandbox="allow-same-origin", sandbox="allow-forms", and sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-forms". Attacker-controlled framed content can replace itself without user action, enabling framed phishing, content replacement, redirect loops, and limited denial of service, but the issue does not by itself permit script execution or parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.
